SELECT min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.login_state='logged_in'
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.member_key IS NULL

WITH web AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.member_key AS line_mk, o.member_key AS order_mk, p.category,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, 
  sum(net_amount) all_incl_test,
  sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) test_amt,
  sum(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) all_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' AND line_mk IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) member_line,
  sum(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' AND order_mk IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) member_order,
  sum(CASE WHEN category<>'ZZ Test' AND line_mk IS NOT NULL AND order_mk IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) odd
FROM web w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10,11)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH w AS (
  SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected'))
SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(w.net_amount) mine,
  (SELECT sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d2.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d2.fiscal_period=d.fiscal_period) rpt
FROM w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dd WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10,11) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH web_lines AS (
    -- web lines (store 900), dispatched orders only, test articles out, dated on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date,
           f.net_amount,
           -- member taken from the order, because some lines lost member_key (9 Feb - 1 Mar 2026)
           o.member_key AS order_member_key
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN w.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(w.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_pct,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.order_member_key IS NOT NULL AND m.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS orphan_flag
FROM web_lines w
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = w.order_member_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
